_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The Pattern Analyst's historical pattern analysis suggests a transition from Denial to Hope phase, supported by rising Fear/Greed and VIX, indicating fading panic and early optimism.
next_move.confirmed_if: Fear/Greed index crosses 80 and ETF flows accelerate above 75
next_move.invalidated_if: DXY surges above 105 and gold strength reverses below 85
